name: Purple Chrome Nail Beauty Portrait
image_purpose: beauty campaign and nail-art lookbook reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic close-up beauty editorial centered on expressive nail art, layered jewelry, and graphic black-and-white knit styling.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional East Asian woman with natural glowing skin, dark brown eyes, long dark hair with soft face-framing strands, pink blush, red-tinted lips, layered silver necklaces, a black-and-white oversized striped knit sweater, and long almond nails with purple marble, silver chrome, galaxy details, and tiny rhinestones.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up vertical portrait on a bright white seamless background, face centered, one hand making a playful frame beside the eye and the other near the cheek rather than the mouth, jewelry and nail art clearly visible, shallow depth of field.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft bright studio light, high-key clean background, flattering realistic skin, crisp nail and jewelry highlights.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm lens at f/1.4, photorealistic beauty editorial detail, natural pores, accurate hands and fingers, vertical 832x1216-style composition, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic close-up beauty editorial portrait of a clearly adult fictional East Asian woman with natural glowing skin, large dark brown eyes, dark hair with face-framing strands, pink blush, red-tinted lips, layered silver crystal necklaces, black-and-white oversized striped knit sweater, long almond nails with purple marble and silver chrome galaxy nail art and tiny rhinestones, playful finger-frame gesture beside one eye with the other hand near the cheek, bright white seamless background, soft studio lighting, 85mm f/1.4, crisp realistic texture, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, finger in mouth, touching lips, sexualized gesture, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, deformed hands, extra fingers, watermark, logo, text, plastic skin, cartoon, 3d render

assets.name: purple chrome nail portrait reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied source image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Match the nail-art design, striped knit, layered jewelry, hair framing, high-key background, and close-up styling; keep the adult fictional identity and hand placement replaceable.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the beauty-editorial and nail-art intent while moving the hand away from the lips to a nonsexual face-framing gesture. Identity, wardrobe accents, and background remain replaceable.

policy_review.changes: Clarified a clearly adult fictional subject and replaced the finger-on-lips gesture with a nonsexual hand-near-cheek/eye pose.
